adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the service now performs a token refresh unconditionally during service setup: it immediately `fetch`es `https://login.salesforce.com/services/oauth2/token`, then updates the credential in DB via `prisma.credential.update(...)` before returning a `jsforce.Connection`. There is no expiry/validity check to avoid the refresh, no timeout/abort on the `fetch`, and no surrounding try/catch to degrade gracefully if Salesforce is slow/down (it throws on non-OK `statusText`). This can turn any Salesforce calendar operation into a network round-trip + DB write and can fail/hang operations that previously could have proceeded using cached tokens.
